label: 0039 · Smoothed in time, 1997–2025 (one QP over all windows of 0024): 0038 with a slow far-field Tokachi-oki state (interim), correlated noise, fixed 747-site network, UNR positions (MAP)
description: 0038 with a slow far-field state for the 2003 Tokachi-oki earthquake on the base-of-elastic-layer sheet: one Hokkaido-wide slip pattern (300 km Gaussian taper around the centroid) whose prior decays as an Omori law with c = 1 yr. In 0038 the post-Tokachi-oki transient across Hokkaido had no state of its own. The new state takes the island-wide east-southeast motion of the first years (about 11 mm/yr in the first month, 1–2 mm/yr in 2006–2011) and lowers the Hokkaido residual RMS for 2003–2011 from 8.9 to 6.4 mm/yr. While it is active it replaces the per-window BEL term everywhere, including beneath Kyushu, so southwest Japan fits slightly worse in 2003–2011. The block rotations, re-estimated from the 1997–2011 windows, barely change, and the model still runs 6–7 mm/yr east of the 1997–2003 Hokkaido velocities. An interim model: time-varying block rotations are being tested next. Window cross-validation is 349 above 0038's (706 above 0037's) and higher in every window. MAP solution, no posterior SD.
